appDescription: Generate random values and process developer text locally.
promptCopied: AI prompt copied without inputs or results. Paste it into the chat yourself.
aiHelpPrompt: Copy a prompt for the current tool, then paste it into the chat yourself. Inputs and results are not included, and nothing is sent automatically.
aiHelpPermission: Enable agent.tools and allow the tool in the host before AI can call it.
aiHelpData: For other tools, parameters, input text and outputs may be visible to the model. Never submit secrets or private data.
aiHelpSecrets: AI-generated passwords and keys are shown only in their tool panel, masked by default; their values are not returned to the model.
aiGenerated: AI generated {count} result(s). Values are shown only in this tool panel, not returned to the model.
aiResultNotice: AI-generated password or key. The values stay in this tool panel and are not returned to the model.
lengthHint: 1–128 characters including prefix/suffix. Short strings are for identifiers or tests; use 20+ characters for passwords.
excludeConfusing: Exclude look-alike characters (0, O, 1, l, I)
rangeLength: Choose a random length in a range
customOnly: Use only a custom character set
customHint: Custom-only mode replaces the selected groups. Username mode still requires a leading letter.
keyBytesHint: JWT minimum: HS256 32, HS384 48, HS512 64 bytes. General-purpose: 16–128 bytes.
keyResultInfo: {bytes} random bytes · {bits} random bits · {encoding} · {chars} encoded characters. Encoding adds no entropy.
keyHint: Generates a secret, not a JWT token or an asymmetric key pair.
portExcludeHint: Separate individual ports or inclusive ranges with commas.
portSafety: Port numbers are suggestions only. No ports are opened or scanned; availability is not checked.
inspectTitle: Look up a common service port
inspectHint: Uses the host's service list only. No match does not mean the port is available.
inspectMatch: Port {port}: {service}. Category: {category}. This does not confirm availability.
inspectNoMatch: Port {port}: no common service listed. Category: {category}. This does not confirm availability.
staleHint: These results use the previous settings. Run the tool again to apply changes.
staleStatus: Settings changed. Existing results use the previous settings.
copied: Copied. Clear sensitive clipboard contents after use.
clipboardWarning: The clipboard may be read by other applications. Clear sensitive values after use.
privacyNote: Inputs and results are not saved. All tools run locally in the Breezell host.
invalidCount: Enter a whole-number count between 1 and 100.
invalidLength: Enter a valid length or length range between 1 and 128.
emptyCharset: Select at least one non-empty character set.
requiredGroupEmpty: A required character group is empty after exclusions.
impossibleRules: The selected rules cannot be satisfied. Check length, required groups, prefix and suffix.
insufficientSpace: Not enough unique values are available for this count and these rules.
attemptsExceeded: Could not produce enough distinct results within the safety limit. Reduce the count or widen the options.
invalidKeySize: Choose 16–128 random bytes, and meet the selected JWT algorithm's minimum.
invalidEncoding: Choose Base64url, Base64 or hexadecimal encoding.
invalidPortRange: Enter an inclusive port range between 1 and 65535, with minimum no greater than maximum.
invalidPortExclusions: Enter excluded ports or ranges such as 8080, 9000-9010, within 1–65535.
invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Check the options and try again.
unknownError: The operation could not be completed.
clipboardFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Please try again.
notSignedIn: Sign in to Breezell to use this tool.
blocked: This tool is blocked by the current host policy.
hostOnly: Open this page in Breezell to generate and copy results.
uuidNotice: Creates UUID v4 identifiers in the host. UUIDs are not passwords or signing secrets.
toolInputHint: Up to 65,536 characters; the host also limits UTF-8 input to 64 KiB. Input clears on tool switches, sign-out or Clear.
hashNotice: MD5 and SHA-1 are for compatibility checks only, not security. These digests are not password-storage algorithms.
timestampNotice: Dates must include an explicit ISO timezone, such as Z or +08:00. Results show UTC, Unix seconds and milliseconds.
base64Notice: Base64 is an encoding, not encryption. Decoded data may contain sensitive information.
urlNotice: Parses HTTP(S) URLs locally without requesting or opening them. Credentials and query parameters may be sensitive.
jwtNotice: Decoded only, not verified. No signature validation or authorization decision is performed; claims do not prove validity or expiry.
resultHidden: Result hidden. Select Show to reveal.
inputTooLarge: The UTF-8 input exceeds 64 KiB. Reduce the input and try again.
outputTooLarge: The output exceeds the safety limit. Reduce the input or count.
invalidText: Enter supported text without invalid Unicode characters.
invalidHash: Choose SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 with hexadecimal or Base64 output.
invalidBase64: Enter valid Base64 or Base64url for the selected variant, or valid hexadecimal input.
invalidUtf8: The decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8. Choose hexadecimal output for binary data.
invalidTimestamp: Enter a supported timestamp and select seconds or milliseconds.
invalidDate: Enter a valid ISO date with an explicit timezone (Z or ±HH:MM).
invalidJwt: Enter a three-part JWS token with valid Base64url JSON header and payload.
invalidUuidFormat: Choose standard or compact UUID format.
